search_queries: targeted PyPI and project-documentation lookups for nine named XML parsers
uncertainty: Four verified third-party paths (lxml, beautifulsoup4, xmltodict and untangle) are selected from nine named PyPI/project-documentation leads. A bounded PyPI Simple Index search remains pending; 5 leads are unresolved, so this is not a completed top-ten ranking. lxml uses source-built libxml2 2.15.4; beautifulsoup4's documented 'xml' builder runs on the same lxml 6.1.3/libxml2 2.15.4 pins (shared parser family, no independent XML tokenizer, recover=True); xmltodict, untangle (SAX via defusedxml's DefusedExpatParser) and the standard ElementTree path use Expat. untangle runs SAX without namespace processing and drops namespace URIs; its controls are checked against an lxml oracle projected to untangle's qualified-name view, not against namespace-expanded names. The lxml, beautifulsoup4 and untangle controls exercise valid UTF-8 XML 1.0 namespace structures without DOCTYPE, not full XML conformance. PyPI Stats package downloads are not XML-specific use; Beautiful Soup downloads are mostly HTML use. lxml and beautifulsoup4 AFL feedback excludes parser.c lines 8700-8720 because address-sensitive attribute hash lookups varied across identical valid replays.
